property_summary: After owner deposits 1 ether via fallback, owner sends 0.5 ether via sendMoney to a random address, non-owner calls sendMoney to the contract itself with 0.5 ether: reference reverts the last call (onlyOwner) so balance remains 0.5 ether, buggy allows it resulting in balance 1 ether.
change_summary: Change onlyOwner to allow any caller, so sendMoney becomes callable by anyone, altering balance on unauthorized calls.
